name: reuse-product-components
description: A designer asks agents to reuse approved components when extending an existing product interface.

judgment.statement: Reuse existing product components and design tokens before introducing a new visual pattern.
judgment.rationale: One-off components diverge from the product and create repeated design review and maintenance work.

limits: Applies to existing product interfaces, not unconstrained concept exploration.
A missing component or accessibility problem can justify proposing a new pattern for review.

evidence.summary: Explicit synthetic guidance; not a measured task outcome.
